test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence is describing how** the tuatara's teeth differ from those of other reptiles.**
 
• **"Distinct" **is the appropriate adjective that conveys how the teeth are notably different.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Sharp – Incorrect, as "sharp" describes the quality of being pointed and does not adequately capture the idea of being different in kind or form.
 
• **Option 3:** Discrete – Incorrect, as "discrete" means individually separate and distinct, which is a very specific usage and not as fitting in this context.
 
• **Option 4:** Separate – Incorrect, as "separate" does not precisely describe the quality of being noticeably different in nature or kind.
